description_en: Calls the GetConversationList operation to retrieve a list of sessions
description_zh: 调用GetConversationList接口获取会话列表
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot get-conversation-list --instance-id chatbot-cn-7QuUfaqMQe --session-id c1187530338311ebade7cf3eaeb3668a --sender-id 83325 --start-date 2020-12-01_11:17:38 --end-date 2020-12-01_11:17:38 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --agent-key ac627989eb4f8a98ed05fd098bbae5_p_beebot_public --api-version 2017-10-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetConversationList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the chatbot instance. Log on to the Chatbot console, choose Developer > Basic Configuration in the left-side navigation pane, and then view the chatbot instance information to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 机器⼈实例ID。登录云⼩蜜控 制台，左侧⾯板选择开发者-> 基本配置，查看机器⼈示例信 息，可获得该实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The session ID, which is used to identify a visitor's session and maintain context information. For a new visitor, you do not need to pass this field when calling the Chat operation for the first time. The chatbot starts a session and returns the SessionId of the session in the response of the Chat operation. For subsequent conversation turns of the visitor, pass the SessionId of the current session when calling the Chat operation. The chatbot then continues the conversation turn based on the SessionId
parameters.help_zh:
会话ID，⽤于标识⼀个访问者 的会话和保持上下⽂信息。对
于⼀个新的访问者，⾸次调⽤ Chat接⼝时⽆需传递此字段， 机器⼈会开启⼀个会话，并在 Chat接⼝的响应中返回该会话 的SessionId。对于该访问者的 后续轮次的会话，调⽤Chat接
⼝时传递当前会话的 SessionId，机器⼈即可基于 SessionId继续该轮次会话
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The visitor ID. This parameter is used to identify the user in the current session
parameters.help_zh:
访问者ID。⽤于识别当前会话
中的⽤户
parameters.name: sender_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value on the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不传时访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key
